title: Governing Agentic AI in FinTech
abstract: arXiv:2608.11344v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Financial institutions are delegating consequential decisions to agentic AI systems that decompose goals, coordinate models and tools, and act with little oversight. Yet agentic AI governance in FinTech is under-investigated. We argue the binding governance constraint is not capability but verifiability. We define the Verifiability Gap as the shortfall between the verification delegated authority demands and the explainability and reproducibility retained after a decision. It is indexed to a verifier, evidentiary standard, and audit lag. We develop a multilevel governance theory for agentic AI and test its mechanisms in three studies over nine model versions, from a three-billion-parameter local model to a commercial frontier system. Study 1 shows that provider releases alter historical financial actions, and that the controls replay needs belong to the provider: the frontier model rejects temperature, top_p and top_k outright and expo

translated_title: 金融科技中代理型AI的治理
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.11344v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：金融机构正在将关键决策委托给代理型AI系统，这些系统能分解目标、协调模型和工具，并在极少监督下行动。然而，金融科技中的代理型AI治理尚未得到充分研究。我们认为，治理的约束性瓶颈并非能力，而是可验证性。我们将“可验证性差距”定义为委托权限所要求的验证与决策后保留的可解释性和可复现性之间的差距。该差距以验证者、证据标准和审计滞后为指标。我们为代理型AI开发了一个多层次治理理论，并在三个研究中对九个模型版本（从三十亿参数的本地模型到商业前沿系统）测试了其机制。研究1显示，提供商发布改变了历史金融行为，且重放控制需求属于提供商：前沿模型直接拒绝温度、top_p和top_k参数，并暴露其行为。
tldr: 本文提出代理型AI治理的关键在于可验证性差距，并开发了多层次治理理论，实证表明金融科技中AI治理需由提供商控制重放机制。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that the key governance constraint for agentic AI is verifiability, defines the Verifiability Gap, and develops a multilevel governance theory, empirically showing that provider-controlled replay mechanisms are essential in FinTech AI governance.
